commands_used: answer 1. I am Tarin, a thief of Nesh-Deeka house. The knight-captain disc carries a pick-and-tower mark that Nesh-Deeka says is Vicrium, an old mine, where the knights kept a strongbox. It is on the trail to the Eye of Argonia, and the Unbound are ahead of us. 2. Ask Ah-Zish, the gallery-boss here at Vicrium, about the knights strongbox. 3. I can talk to Ah-Zish, or try the locked door to the Lower Galleries (needs a pick or key), or the Old Lower Adit. There is also a Crocodile here. 4. I do not understand why the Unbound seal trees with paralysis paste, or who the "we" is that listens. Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel and Ennodius Vanin are unknown. I could ask people along the way.

answer 1. Ah-Zish locked the lower galleries after a roof fall and hears voices below, likely smugglers coming by the flooded crocodile adit. The knights strongbox is down there. 2. Get the key from Ah-Zish, then find the strongbox in the lower galleries. 3. Persuade him, pay 100 gold, pickpocket the key (risk: he shouts for miners), or try the flooded adit with crocodiles. The door cannot be picked. 4. Nothing new that I do not understand, except who the smugglers are, maybe Unbound; I will find out below.

answer 1. I got into the lower galleries of Vicrium with a key lifted from Ah-Zish, killed a smuggler, and found an old parchment map in the knights strongbox: seven towers in the sea and a tooth-shaped crag on an island. It is probably a lead toward the Eye of Argonia. 2. Bring the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. 3. Go straight back to Helstrom, or look at the map and explore more first. I could also read the map before leaving. 4. I do not know what the seven towers or the tooth crag are, or who the smugglers worked for (maybe the Unbound). Nesh-Deeka or the map itself may tell me.

answer 1. I gave Nesh-Deeka the map. She said the Unbound had not reached Vicrium, without saying how she knew. She promoted me to Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, paid 200 gold and offered the orders weapon. 2. Choose a rapier or a quarterstaff from Nesh-Deeka, here in her house in Helstrom. 3. Rapier or quarterstaff. As a thief I favour the rapier, light and quick. 4. I still do not know who "we" is in "we listen", what the seven towers and tooth crag mean (her officer is to read them), or the four unknown names. I could ask her how she knows.

answer 1. I took the rapier. Nesh-Deeka answered how she knew only with "We listen". She now passes me to her officer Never-Writes-Twice, who wants to see the map. 2. Show the map to Never-Writes-Twice, at the back of this same room. 3. Just talk to her; I could also ask Nesh-Deeka what Toh-Wo means. 4. Still unknown: who "we" are who listen, what the seven towers and tooth crag are, and the names Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, Ennodius Vanin. Never-Writes-Twice may read the map for me.

answer 1. The Vicrium quest is done. The map shows the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha. Never-Writes-Twice marked it, and warned me that Cuts-the-Old-Knot was once of the order, went mad on sap, killed her minders, and I should not listen to her. 2. Nothing is set yet; the next step is presumably to go to Skeith Isle via Archon and Arorha. 3. Ask Never-Writes-Twice more, or head for the boat to Archon/Arorha. 4. Unknown still: who "we" are who listen, why the Unbound seal trees with paralysis paste, Xeech-Leel, Umbriel, Ennodius Vanin, and the seven towers meaning.

answer I am Tarin, now Toh-Wo (Secret-Speaker) of Nesh-Deeka house in Helstrom, reporting to her officer Never-Writes-Twice. At Vicrium, Ah-Zish gave no key by talk (the dialogue handoff failed twice, with 100 gold apparently taken once), so I pickpocketed it, killed a smuggler in the lower galleries and took the Old Parchment Map from the knights strongbox. Never-Writes-Twice read it: the tooth crag is the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha, and she marked it. I carry the Toh-Wo rapier, 2 lockpicks, 3 Grey Seal paralysis poisons, Keystone, Eye-Setting, Bronze Disc, map, and about 850 gold. Warned: Cuts-the-Old-Knot was of the order, went mad on sap and killed her minders, so do not listen to her. Nesh-Deeka says "We listen" about how she knows things, and does not say who. Open questions: why the Unbound seal trees with paralysis paste, who Xeech-Leel, Umbriel and Ennodius Vanin are, the seven towers. Next: take a boat to Archon and Arorha, then Skeith Isle.
